steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops on its own once the last one lands.
Follow the roadmap order: story first (60-80 h), then the 100% checklist (~100 h), then Strangers and cleanup (~10 h).
Keep cheats off the whole run: sources report cheats disable trophies and saving.

1.window: Story: unlocks while playing the story; cannot be missed by finishing the story.

dispute.title: How long is the platinum, really?

a.label: About 200 hours
a.text: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, OutputLag and GTA Vibes all put the platinum at about 200 hours.

b.label: Up to 300 hours or more
b.text: PushSquare estimates up to 300 hours or more. The gap is play style and how much of the 100% checklist is done during the story.

steps.t: Play the story through until the opening mission, Gone Fishing is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.
No extra requirement: the official description asks only for this story beat.

steps.t: Finish the story first: the 100% Completion Checklist only appears afterwards, under Progress > Stats.
Work the checklist line by line (about 100 h): robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, shooting ranges, drone races, card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges.
Progress made during the story already counts, so scan vehicles and study animals as you go.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist hits 100%.

14.window: Story: unlocks while playing the story; cannot be missed by finishing the story.

steps.t: Pull off stunts anywhere in Leonida: jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the 250.
Track the total under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and check the map for stunt spots.
Fold stunts into normal travel instead of grinding them in one sitting: 250 is a long count.

15.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Try each of the nine activity types once: the count is nine, per KeenGamer.
Activities include the shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade games and bowling, among others.
The trophy pops as soon as the ninth different type is tried.

16.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Visit the shooting ranges and work through all 42 challenges.
Each challenge needs a gold medal: replay a challenge until the gold standard is met.
The trophy pops when the last challenge turns gold.

17.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Find the Top Fun drone races: there is one at each of 14 locations.
Win a race at every location; a win at a location you already won does not add a new one.
Save the races for after the story if you like: nothing here is missable.

18.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Enter races across Leonida and win 20 different ones.
Each race counts once: winning the same race again does not raise the total.
Mix race types as you travel; wins during the story already count.

19.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and beat him.
Fishing challenges open through the fishing activity; keep trying until the challenge is won.
Nothing here is missable: the challenge stays available after the story.

20.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Find an arcade machine and play a full arcade game through to its end.
Any arcade game counts; the trophy pops when the game is completed.
Arcade games stay available after the story.

21.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Find Andy's missions as they appear during the story and play each one when it shows.
Keep going through the whole chain: the trophy pops only after Andy's final mission.
Save before each story chapter: the chain's missions are tied to story progress, so do not rush past a chapter without checking for new icons.

steps.t: Play Strangers & Freaks mission strands as their icons appear across Leonida.
Complete 8 full strands: a strand counts only when its missions are all done.
Some strands belong to the named stranger chains (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone); finishing those helps the total.
Nothing here is missable after the story, but check for new stranger icons before each chapter ends.

steps.t: FIRST, in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, check Jason's house in the morning. When Lucia says she will meditate, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
Then meditate at every marked spot across Leonida: 18 spots at 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia each counting at a spot.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Make a manual save before leaving Chapter 1: the balcony meditation cannot be repeated afterwards.

28.window: Chapter 1 only — after Chapter 1 the balcony meditation is gone for good. Save before leaving Chapter 1.

dispute.title: How many meditations does it take?

a.label: Conservative — 18 spots
a.text: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and PushSquare all say 18 meditation spots. Track 18 to be safe.

b.label: Minimum — 15 spots
b.text: KeenGamer notes the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations. Some readers count 15 as the trophy's real target.

c.label: Does the Chapter 1 balcony count?
c.text: OutputLag says the balcony meditation counts toward the total. PowerPyx says it raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed.

steps.t: Take Bret's hunting work: the trophy asks for one unique animal hunted for him.
Follow Bret's strand to its hunt; the trophy pops when the unique animal is hunted.
The exact animal and trigger are not spelled out in the sources we read, so treat the strand itself as the route and check Bret's missions first.

29.window: Story: unlocks while playing the story; cannot be missed by finishing the story.

steps.t: Collect cards across Leonida and complete 3 full Collectible Card sets.
A set counts only when every card in it is found.
Card hunting fits the post-story cleanup: nothing here is missable.

30.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app and scan spots: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures count.
Scan 100 different locations; scanning the same spot twice does not add to the total.
Scan as you travel during the story: progress already counts toward the 100% checklist.

31.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Open the Challenges list and complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing the platinum.
Pick the easiest challenges first; progress counts from the start of the game.

32.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Reach a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you.
Then lose the wanted level and escape the heat without being caught.
Bank vault robberies raise wanted level fast, so this often pops naturally during the vault grind.

33.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner.
Keep your wanted level the whole way through all three robberies.
Plan a short route between three nearby shops before starting.

34.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida.
Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you find them: the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 models, so keep scanning past 100.
New vehicles keep appearing after the story, so nothing here is missable.

35.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Build Combat Focus first: food, drinks or a shower at home help, and Adrenaline helps too.
Enter a fight with at least 5 enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and take down 5 enemies in that single use.
An assault rifle suits the attempt; retry the fight if the count falls short.

36.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Go to VCIA, the airport, and leave by an unscheduled route instead of a normal exit.
The trophy pops when the unscheduled departure is made.
Nothing here is missable after the story.

37.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Find a Rhino tank and get into the situation the description hints at: it stays hot inside the Rhinos.
The exact trigger is not spelled out in the sources we read, so this one is marked unconfirmed in our audit.
Try it in free-roam after the story, where tanks and open space are both available.

38.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and plan the robbery before going in.
Rob the store without being detected: stay out of sight lines and move quietly.
If you are spotted, leave and try another store: detection voids the attempt.

39.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Find the bank vaults and rob one, then escape cleanly.
Repeat for 5 different bank vaults; each escape counts once.
Vault robberies raise your wanted level fast, which also helps Hot Together.

40.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road and rob it.
Escape after the robbery: the trophy pops on a clean getaway.
Armored trucks keep spawning after the story.

steps.t: Explore every area of Leonida until the whole map is covered.
Check the map for unexplored corners after the story and drive or fly through them.
Exploration counts from the start, so most of the map is usually done by the end of the story.

42.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Find the illegal operations run by each gang across Leonida.
Rob one operation belonging to each gang.
Operations stay available after the story, so work through them during cleanup.

steps.t: Build the partnership the description hints at: a partnership with mass appeal.

47.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Keep making choices as you play: the in-game count tracks them toward 500.
Choices appear in missions and in the open world; there is no single spot to grind them.
The 500 figure is reported, not confirmed in two sources, so the count is shown as reported here.

48.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: The description says: second time's the charm. The trigger is a second attempt that succeeds.
The exact activity is not confirmed in the sources we read, so this one is marked unconfirmed in our audit.
Retry failed activities rather than reloading: a second try is what the trophy is about.

49.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: The description asks what just happened: witness something strange in Leonida.
The exact event and place are not confirmed in the sources we read, so this one is marked unconfirmed in our audit.
Explore odd corners of the map in free-roam; strange events are reported in the open world.

50.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: The description asks for a melee drive-by that bowls someone over.
The exact method is still being confirmed in the sources we read, so this one is marked unconfirmed in our audit.
Attempt it in free-roam where traffic and open road give room for a drive-by.

51.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Collect Marked Bills, then launder them through your contacts.
Keep laundering until $250,000 has gone through your contacts.
Laundering fits the post-story money cleanup.

52.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Spend money across all shops in Leonida.
Keep spending until the total reaches $100,000.
Shop spending during the story already counts.

53.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Find every garage property for sale across Leonida.
Purchase all of them; the trophy pops when the last one is bought.
Garages stay for sale after the story.

54.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles to it.
Register 10 different vehicles.
Vehicles discovered during the story count once registered.

55.window: After the story: stays available in free-roam.
